rule: Stock video is context, not proof. Historical claims require source photos, maps, documents, or archival footage with rights-ledger rows.

providers.name: Pexels
providers.enabled_when: API key exists and license page/source URL is logged

providers.name: Pixabay
providers.enabled_when: API key exists and license page/source URL is logged

providers.name: Mixkit
providers.enabled_when: download page and license proof are logged

providers.name: Coverr
providers.enabled_when: download page and license proof are logged

providers.name: Unsplash
providers.enabled_when: video-capable source and license proof are logged
providers.allowed_role: modern context only when video is available

providers.name: Videezy
providers.enabled_when: item-specific license is commercial-use compatible and no attribution/watermark blocker exists

hard_blocks: stock footage used as historical proof
stock footage before source proof in the first 20 seconds
